versions.name: Scope
versions.text: Look at the 2 cards at the top of your opponent's deck and choose one. Send it to the bottom of their deck.
versions.note: Not listed in Version History for this card; assumed Beta 51.1 (the earliest it could be - seen by 2020-10-18).
